# Haynes Home Improvements Ltd

> Bespoke design and build of fitted furniture in England and Wales: fitted wardrobes, fitted bedrooms, walk-in wardrobes and dressing rooms, media walls and TV units, loft and eaves storage, under-stairs storage, home offices and kitchens. Based in Bedford with an office in London, covering up to about 200 miles from Bedford (London, Birmingham, Manchester, Leeds, Bristol, Cardiff and in between).

## Key facts
- Legal name: Haynes Home Improvements Ltd (Companies House 16815192, incorporated 28 October 2025)
- Office: 5th Floor, 167-169 Great Portland Street, London W1W 5PF
- Freephone: 0800 302 9909
- WhatsApp: 0737 923 6186
- Email: sales@hayneshomeimprovementsltd.co.uk
- Coverage: up to about 200 miles from Bedford; England and Wales
- How it works: free home visit and measure, a design and clear price before anything is made, made to measure, fitted and the room left clean
- Reviews: rated 5.0 from 6 Google reviews and 5.0 from 6 Bark reviews
